title: rosa communis var. adscita
intro: Rosa communis var. adscita, commonly known as Rosa canina, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, producing fragrant flowers and edible fruits. The health benefits of Rosa canina include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues and its potential to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure due to its high content of antioxidants and essential fatty acids. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
